stem: Which sentence shows that people are interested in learning about Tama?

options.label: A
options.text: She spent most of her time at Kishi Station.

options.label: B
options.text: She walks around the station in her uniform and greets passengers.

options.label: C
options.text: Tama has been featured in many newspaper and magazine articles as well as on television shows and in video clips.

options.label: D
options.text: From stray cat to famous stationmaster, life is sweet for Tama!
